articles.title: Bitcoin slides below $82,000 as AI doubts return, with DeFi tokens leading declines
articles.description: Bitcoin as much as 2.9% to around $81,600 as Nasdaq futures dropped, while the CoinDesk 80 lost 3.5% and DeFi index slid 6%.

articles.title: Crypto traders price India telecoms company Reliance Jio's IPO at about $110 billion
articles.description: The pre-IPO Jio contract on Bitget is trading near $12, a roughly 4% premium on the top price band, as India’s largest public offering remains open for subscription.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin’s round trip to $85,000 burns traders on both sides
articles.description: Bitcoin gave back its run at $85,000 and broke below $82,500 as weak tech earnings soured the mood. XMR bucked the drop with an 11% jump.

articles.title: Asian stocks tumble, bitcoin retreats as China enters bear market
articles.description: Technology shares led regional losses as mixed U.S. earnings unsettled investors and Brent crude climbed above $112 a barrel.

articles.title: China seeks to seize 61,800 BTC tied to $5.7 billion fraud scheme
articles.description: Chinese prosecutors are seeking to confiscate more than 61,800 Bitcoin tied to a $5.7 billion fraud scheme, days after a U.K. court ruled Chinese law governs victims’ claims to the coins.

articles.title: Solana’s biggest network change since 2020 is live. Here’s how users benefit
articles.description: The new voting system targets settlement in about 150 milliseconds, potentially shortening waits for payments and deposits. Users can keep their existing wallets.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs attract $1.08 billion in 3 days but it may not be enough for a steep rally
articles.description: Past steep rallies ran on about $235 million a day of net inflows into ETFs. The funds are yet to match that pace, according to data analyzed by CoinDesk.

articles.title: XRP Ledger bug fix moved to November after validator support dipped for two hours
articles.description: The fix lost its two-week countdown less than two days from the finish after support slipped to 26 of 35 validators. It’s now back at 31.

articles.title: Bitcoin gives back its run at $85,000 as Tesla and Meta fail to calm AI nerves
articles.description: BTC broke through its $84,000 ceiling late Wednesday, then slid back to the $82,500 support analysts are watching as tech futures fell.

articles.title: Trump to throw spotlight on overseas crypto abuses at White House event
articles.description: The president is hosting a cybercrime event that will highlight U.S. authorities' efforts to crack down on crypto scams run by foreign criminal organizations.

articles.title: How a16z-backed DATA is rethinking its blockchain strategy after $30 million Sui deal
articles.description: The startup is retiring its own blockchain and moving to Sui with a $30 million investment as it narrows its focus to AI training data.

articles.title: Bybit will look for big broker partnerships to take on Robinhood in the U.S.
articles.description: When it comes to the U.S., Bybit will look to work with with someone like Interactive Brokers (IB), for example, said CEO Ben Zhou.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Why real-world assets need fixed-rate loans onchain
articles.description: Real-world assets already back the largest stablecoins, yet borrowing against them onchain still runs through variable-rate pools. Peter Gaffney of O2O Capital Partners explains why fixed-rate, fixed-term lending is the missing piece, and how a 5% shift in Sky and Ethena reserves could create $1.8 billion of demand for real-world assets.

articles.title: Why centralized exchanges refuse to list legacy crypto tokens without explicit SEC immunity
articles.description: Vault12 raised $17.45 million selling VGT in 2018 and says it met or dropped every promise, yet the token has never traded on a centralized exchange.

articles.title: Japanese visitors may be able to pay with yen stablecoins in South Korea under Shinhan-SBI pact
articles.description: The collaboration will explore card-linked merchant payments for Japanese visitors in South Korea and peer-to-peer wallet transfers among broader cross-border trade remittances.

articles.title: Dogecoin wallet, app teams unite in push to give DOGE more everyday uses
articles.description: Dogecoin Labs will combine MyDoge, DogeOS and merchant payment tools as developers try to turn coin holders into customers for applications and businesses.

articles.title: Bitcoin risk management grows more popular as the 'just bet on price' era fades
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 21, 2026

articles.title: OCC's final rule to start fresh in weighing stablecoin rewards against GENIUS Act ban
articles.description: The U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency is the first of several federal agencies to finish writing regulations under the act.

articles.title: Crypto rises with Asian tech stocks, zcash extends gain after setting upgrade date
articles.description: Bitcoin rose to a one-week high as Asian tech stocks rebounded and SpaceX and Tesla formed committees to explore a merger.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds above $84,000 as Middle East worries resurface
articles.description: South Korea data center player Elice surged 30% after plunging about the same amount following its IPO one day earlier.

articles.title: SpaceX and Tesla explore merger that would unite more than 30,000 bitcoin
articles.description: Independent committees are assessing a potential tie-up, while strong SpaceX earnings lift shares ahead of Tesla’s results.

articles.title: Monero futures are again heating with leverage, raising volatility risks
articles.description: Open interest has topped $300 million and price is back above $600. A similar setup was seen before January's crash.

articles.title: Tether leads $15 million funding round for AI-focused payment startup Mural
articles.description: The Series A round, which included participation from North Island Ventures and existing investors, brings New York-based Mural's total funding to $28 million.

articles.title: Zcash developers confirm November date for upgrade that triples payment speed
articles.description: The NU7 upgrade will cut the time between Zcash blocks to 25 seconds from 75 seconds. The chosen block height still has to be merged into the spec and shipped in node software.

articles.title: Ripple brings Wall Street into 24/7 stock bets, but HSBC warns markets are still thin
articles.description: Institutions can trade through Ripple Prime and post RLUSD as collateral. Finding enough buyers and sellers for large positions could prove harder.
